title: Slash commands integration with MCP server tools
body:
I think MCP server tools should be designed so they can be easily selected with slash commands, as shown in this image.
The Obsidian MCP tools happen to be displayed in slash commands, but I believe they should be automatically integrated with Claude Code CLI.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/669f6f5d-ad0c-4a74-91ea-8cc909550216)
author: kawa0721
